envFile.title: Its .env file can be downloaded
envFile.advice: Anyone could read the secrets in it. Serve a build folder instead of the project folder, or block dotfiles in the server's settings.

gitRepository.title: Its .git folder can be downloaded
gitRepository.advice: The repository's history and remotes can be downloaded. Serve a build folder instead of the project folder, or block dotfiles.

dsStore.title: A .DS_Store file lists the folder's files
dsStore.advice: It reveals file names that aren't linked anywhere. Delete it, or block dotfiles in the server's settings.

directoryListing.title: It lists the files in its folder
directoryListing.advice: Visitors can browse and download every file there. Turn off directory listings, or serve only a build folder.

backupArchive.title: A backup archive can be downloaded
backupArchive.advice: Move backups out of the folder being served.

databaseDump.title: A database dump can be downloaded
databaseDump.advice: Move dumps out of the folder being served; they hold your data.

databaseFile.title: A SQLite database can be downloaded
databaseFile.advice: Move the database file out of the folder being served.

djangoDebug.title: Django runs with DEBUG = True
djangoDebug.advice: Error pages show settings, code and URL patterns. Set DEBUG = False for anything public.

laravelDebug.title: Laravel's debug tools are on
laravelDebug.advice: Ignition and Whoops show code and environment details, and old Ignition versions allow running code. Set APP_DEBUG=false.

railsDevelopment.title: Rails runs in development mode
railsDevelopment.advice: Error pages, web-console or better_errors show code and can run commands. Run it in production mode to share it.

symfonyProfiler.title: Symfony's profiler is reachable
symfonyProfiler.advice: It shows requests, configuration and environment variables. Turn off the web profiler (APP_ENV=prod).

springActuator.title: Spring Boot's actuator shows the environment
springActuator.advice: /actuator/env lists configuration and environment. Don't expose the env endpoint, or require a login for actuator.

phpInfo.title: phpinfo() is reachable
phpInfo.advice: It shows the server's configuration and environment. Delete the file.

stackTrace.title: Error pages show stack traces
stackTrace.advice: Traces reveal code paths and libraries. Run the app in production mode, or show a plain error page.

openAdmin.title: An admin panel opens without a login
openAdmin.advice: Anyone could change your data. Log out of it, or require a login on the share.

databaseTool.title: A database tool (Adminer or phpMyAdmin) is reachable
databaseTool.advice: Anyone could try to sign in to your databases. Remove it from what you share, or require a login on the share.

databasePort.title: This port is a database, not a website
databasePort.advice: Sharing it over HTTP won't work, and a database shouldn't be public. For a database, use a TCP route with a login instead.

jupyter.title: Jupyter runs without a token
jupyter.advice: Anyone could run code on this computer. Start Jupyter with a token or password.

sourceMap.title: Source maps include your source code
sourceMap.advice: Visitors can read the original code. That's usually fine for a demo; turn off source maps in the build otherwise.

permissionFix.title_one: The token needs one more permission
permissionFix.tunnelsWhy: To create the tunnel and serve routes through it.
permissionFix.dnsWhy: To add the route's DNS record on {zone}. Include {zone} under Zone Resources.
permissionFix.anyDnsWhy: To add routes' DNS records. Include your domains under Zone Resources.
permissionFix.accessApps: Account · Access: Apps and Policies · Edit
permissionFix.accessAppsWhy: To put a login in front of a route.
permissionFix.accessOrg: Account · Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups · Edit
permissionFix.accessOrgWhy: To add the one-time code login method when the account has none.
permissionFix.editDetail: Add them to this account's API token in Cloudflare. The token itself stays the same, so there's nothing to paste.
permissionFix.step1: Choose Edit next to the token you connected (Cloudflare names it “Teitunnel” if you used the link).
permissionFix.step2: Add the permissions above, and check that this account and your domains are included under the resources.
permissionFix.step3: Choose Continue to Summary, then Update Token.
permissionFix.autoCheck: Teitunnel checks again when you come back.
permissionFix.stillMissing: The token still lacks some of them. Check the permissions and that this account and domain are included.
permissionFix.newTokenDetail: Create a token with every permission Teitunnel uses, then paste it here. It replaces this account's current credential.
permissionFix.otherDetail: This account is connected with a login whose permissions can't be changed. Connect it with an API token instead; it replaces the current credential.
permissionFix.lbPools: Account · Load Balancing: Monitors and Pools · Edit
permissionFix.lbWhy: To load balance a route. Load Balancing is a paid Cloudflare add-on: turn it on in the dashboard first.
permissionFix.analyticsWhy: To show each route's traffic as Cloudflare sees it. Include your domains under Zone Resources.
permissionFix.accountAnalyticsWhy: For traffic numbers Cloudflare keeps per account.
permissionFix.workersWhy: To publish Snapshots as Workers on your account.
permissionFix.workersRoutesWhy: To give a Snapshot a hostname on {zone}. Include {zone} under Zone Resources.
permissionFix.zoneWafWhy: To add rules that challenge or block bots and rate limit visitors on one hostname.
permissionFix.transformRulesWhy: To set or remove request and response headers on one hostname.
permissionFix.serviceTokensWhy: To create and revoke tokens that let machines through a login.

zeroTrustFix.title: Set up Cloudflare Zero Trust
zeroTrustFix.detail: Logins use Cloudflare Zero Trust, which is free for up to 50 users. The account hasn't used it yet, and only the dashboard can set it up.
zeroTrustFix.step1: Open Zero Trust and choose a team name.
zeroTrustFix.step2: Pick the Free plan when asked, then come back.
